title: CPSC, Determined Productions Announce Recall of Plush Toys Sold at Kohl's Department Stores
summary: The seams in the toy can tear open and expose small plastic pellets, posing a choking or aspiration hazard to young children who mouth the pellets. Units: 90,000.

title: CPSC, HearthSong Announce Recall of Children's Toy Balls
summary: The wooden rings on the holes of the product may crack, allowing the small wooden heads to fall out and pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 22,500.

title: CPSC, TOMY Company Announce Recall of Pokémon Plush Toys
summary: Tips of sewing needles have been found in the stuffing, posing a puncture hazard. Units: 7,845.

title: CPSC, Select Brands Inc. Announce Recall of Corningware Slow Cookers
summary: The heating element can drop to the bottom of the unit and melt through the plastic outer shell, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 39,000 units.

title: CPSC, The Holmes Group Inc. Announce Recall of Slow Cookers
summary: The handles on the base of the slow cookers can break, posing a risk of burns from hot contents spilling onto consumers. Units: 1.8 million.

title: CPSC, Osram Sylvania Products Inc. Announce Recall of Decorative Light Bulbs
summary: The glass bulb can separate from its base and break during use. The broken glass can present a laceration injury to consumers, the hot broken bulb can present a burn injury to consumers, and an exposed bulb filament can present a shock hazard if handled while power remains applied to the fixture. title: CPSC, Vornado Air Circulation Systems Announce Recall of Portable Electric Heaters
summary: A faulty electrical connection can cause the heater to overheat and stop working, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 1 million.

title: CPSC, Apple Announce Recall of PowerBook Computer Batteries
summary: An internal short can cause the battery cells to overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 28,000.

title: CPSC, Meco Corp. Announce Recall of Red Chairs from Children's Furniture Sets
summary: The red paint on the chair contains excessive lead levels, posing a lead poisoning hazard to young children. Units: About 3,800.

title: CPSC, PTI Sports Inc. Announce Recall of Schwinn Toddler Bicycle Helmets
summary: The helmets do not comply with impact testing requirements in the Consumer Product Safety Act. Units: About 9,000.

title: CPSC, American Signature Announce Recall of Dinette Chairs
summary: The stretch bar, which connects to the chair's legs, can detach during normal use, causing the user to fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 380.

title: CPSC, NIKE Announce Recall of Children's Athletic Shoes
summary: The 1.5-inch to 1.75-inch rubber tab at the top of the heel can detach from the shoe, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 9,000.

title: CPSC, Seventh Avenue Inc. Announce Recall of Kitchen Krumblers Candle
summary: The dried apples and cinnamon in the candle can ignite, causing a flare up and breaking the glass, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,200 units.

title: CPSC, Belkin Corp. Announce Recall of Rackmount Uninterruptible Power Supplies
summary: The UPS outputs were wired incorrectly, creating a reverse polarity configuration and a potential electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,200.

title: CPSC, Vaxcel International Co. Ltd. Announce Second Recall of Ceiling Fans
summary: These ceiling fans were assembled without the proper wire insulation sleeving, which could result in exposed wiring. Consumers could receive an electrical shock during installation or removal. Units: 1,200.

title: CPSC, OTT-LITE Technology Announce Recall of "10,000 Lux Light Box" That Simulates Natural Sunlight
summary: Overheating around the socket (where the bulb fits into the light box) can result in melted plastic and smoke, posing a possible fire and burn hazard. Units: 226.

title: CPSC, PJ Sleep Shop Announce Recall to Repair Bunk Beds
summary: These bunk beds have gaps between parts of the upper bunk end structure that violate the federal safety standard, because they pose entrapment or strangulation hazards to children. title: CPSC, Aviva Sports Announce Recall to Repair Astroslide Water Slides
summary: These water slides have an excessive length of rope attached to the safety mat, that presents a risk of entanglement in the water. This poses a drowning hazard to users. Units: About 7,500.

title: CPSC, BMW Announce Recall of SlideCarver Scooters
summary: The front column of the scooter does not meet impact resistance standards. The handlebar column can break if the scooter hits an object, which can cause the rider to fall and suffer injuries. Units: 161.

title: CPSC, GE Announce Recall of Ranges and Wall Ovens
summary: The ranges and wall ovens have faulty wiring, which can melt and cause the oven to short circuit. The appliance can then stop working and pose a shock hazard to consumers. Units: 28,300.

title: CPSC, Whirlpool Announce Recall of Cooking Products
summary: All of the appliances use faulty wiring, which can overheat, melt through the insulation and cause a short circuit. They may pose a shock hazard to consumers, if the appliance is not properly grounded. Units: 24,500.
